```text
Machine setup: check which setup/host.sh steps are done
```

Usage:

```
lab setup <command>
```

## lab setup check

```text
Checks every step of setup/host.sh on this machine (packages, groups, SSH keys, Tailscale and its serve
rule, /srv/models, ~/llama-swap, time zone; zaphod: lab-actions and lab-watchdog; marvin: GPU memory,
tuned, fan-chip module, power mode, fan curve; both: lab installed and as new as the repo).
Changes nothing. A step that is not done shows the fix to run (printed, never run).
host.sh itself stays the way to set a machine up: it installs Docker and builds lab.
Good result: every line "ok", exit 0.
```

Usage:

```
lab setup check [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --json   one JSON list (for agents)
```
